metadata.description: On-demand professional capabilities for product, engineering, QA, operations, security, and documentation. The assistant combines relevant knowledge to complete the user-authorized task.

plugins.name: pm-agent
plugins.description: Product discovery, specifications, feature inventories, research, roadmaps, changelogs, release preparation, and GitHub status. Select these capabilities directly for the requested product task.

plugins.name: engineer-agent
plugins.description: Repository analysis, technical design, implementation, debugging, tests, and Git delivery. Apply these capabilities directly to the requested engineering outcome.

plugins.name: qa-agent
plugins.description: Exploratory testing, behavior-based acceptance, defect analysis, and regression verification using reproducible evidence and reusable test cases.

plugins.name: devops-agent
plugins.description: Deployment design, CI/CD configuration, environment audits, and incident runbooks grounded in the actual application and target environment.

plugins.name: security-agent
plugins.description: Application security, authorization, dependency risk, and privacy reviews using code evidence, reachability analysis, and actionable findings.

plugins.name: docs-agent
plugins.description: Documentation sites, product and technical documentation, illustrated manuals, release notes, and accuracy audits grounded in implemented behavior.
